articles.abstract: Abstract Statistical learning enables us to identify patterns in our environment and predict future events, thereby supporting a range of motor, cognitive, and linguistic skills. Despite its significance, the developmental trajectory of statistical learning has remained unclear due to a lack of comprehensive longitudinal studies. Cross-sectional research has hinted at enhanced statistical learning in children up to 11-13 years, followed by a decline into adulthood, yet definitive insights require a longitudinal approach. Our study addresses this gap by assessing statistical learning in the same participants at ages 7, 8, 11, and 14. Utilising linear mixed models and latent class analyses, we observe a decline in statistical learning with age, and find that higher executive functions—cognitive functions that underlie higher-order goal-directed behaviour—are associated with this decline. This study provides evidence that statistical learning is more effective in early childhood, offering insights into the developmental trajectory of this fundamental cognitive ability.

articles.title: Yellow protein co-opted to sustain obligate symbiosis in leaf beetles
articles.abstract: Abstract Yellow proteins are best known for their roles in pigmentation, behavior, and development across insects. Here, we uncover their striking evolutionary co-option for a wholly distinct function: sustaining a Paleocene-aged digestive symbiosis in tortoise beetles. We show that a female-specific Yellow forms the gelatinous spheres that encapsulate the bacterium Stammera during vertical transmission, allowing it to subsist extracellularly despite its drastically reduced genome (0.24 Mb) and limited metabolic capacity. Yellow expression is highly localized to symbiont-harboring glands in the ovaries, where the protein is assembled into a matrix and secreted during egg-laying. Functional knockdown of yellow disrupts sphere integrity and compromises symbiont viability under dry conditions, underscoring the protein’s embedding properties and protective role for Stammera . These findings reveal a novel function for an ancient gene family and demonstrate how tortoise beetles have repurposed Yellows to overcome the extreme metabolic constraints faced by their symbionts during extracellular transmission.

articles.abstract: Abstract Earth’s climate has remained habitable for billions of years, a stability usually attributed to a negative feedback from silicate weathering – the chemical breakdown of silicate rocks on land, which consumes atmospheric carbon dioxide faster as climate warms. However, whether temperature or hydrology primarily drives this feedback remains uncertain. Here we show the two controls leave geographic fingerprints: in an ensemble of climate simulations with randomized continents, temperature-controlled weathering depends on tropical land fraction, whereas hydrology-controlled weathering depends on continental fragmentation. Stronger weathering removes more carbon dioxide, cooling the planet, so each regime predicts anti-correlation between temperature and its controlling geography. Reconstructed global temperatures spanning 480 million years are anti-correlated with tropical land fraction, except from roughly 295 to 200 million years ago – overlapping the supercontinent Pangea – when they anti-correlate with continental fragmentation. The mechanism stabilizing Earth’s climate may thus have evolved, with temperature control apparently dominant for most of this period.

Model-free pattern separation of two-color ultrafast X-ray diffraction
articles.abstract: Abstract Two-color X-ray imaging with Free Electron Laser pulses offers a powerful approach for probing ultrafast structural dynamics in nanoscale systems, combining (near-)atomic spatial resolution with femtosecond temporal precision. The first X-ray pulse captures the object’s initial state, while the second, time-delayed pulse records its subsequent evolution. A key challenge lies in disentangling the two patterns simultaneously recorded by the same detector. We demonstrate the realization of this approach on structurally varying nanoscale particles using two X-ray pulses of different photon energies, 1 and 1.2 keV. Sub-micrometer helium nanodroplets generated in vacuum are irradiated by the two X-ray pulses separated in time by up to 750 femtoseconds. Taking advantage of the high photon-energy resolution of the imaging detector, we separate the overlapping diffraction signals by analyzing individual pixel counts and applying pattern recognition. The helium nanodroplets’ spherical shape allows us to cross-validate this approach by fitting the radial scattering profiles with Mie solutions for abichromatic field. The excellent agreement between the two methods, particularly in the sparsely illuminated outer regions of the diffraction patterns where high-resolution structural information is encoded, highlights the quality of this approach and its potential for future advanced X-ray movie techniques.

articles.title: High-resolution structures of human NHE6 and NHE9 elucidate endosomal ion and lipid interactions
articles.abstract: Abstract Endosomal NHE6 (SLC9A6) and NHE9 (SLC9A9) transporters are essential for maintaining pH homeostasis within endosomes and their dysfunction has been linked to neurological and neurodegenerative disorders. NHE6 and NHE9 are widely considered to function as electroneutral exchangers that couple the export of protons to the import of sodium or potassium ions across cellular membranes, thereby forming the basis of proton leak pathways for internal pH balancing and fine-tuning. Among the 13 identified SLC9 family members, only NHE6 and NHE9 are targeted to endosomes. Despite their biological importance and therapeutic potential, the structural basis for their activity and regulation remains elusive. Here, we present the cryo-EM structures of human NHE9 and two splice variants of NHE6 that differ by alternative inclusion of the β-hairpin motif-containing loop domain located between transmembrane helices 2 and 3, showcasing structural diversity within the organellar NHE subfamily. By mapping the sodium-binding site, our results provide mechanistic insights into ion transport, and for NHE6 we provide evidence for a conserved PIP2-mediated regulatory mechanism. These findings provide a framework for understanding endosomal NHE function with implications for disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease and glioblastoma.

articles.title: Diverse biosynthetic pathways in Arctic hydrothermal biofilms
articles.abstract: Abstract Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) which encode diverse secondary metabolites are ubiquitous across microbiomes and support critical ecological functions. They also serve as attractive targets for new drug discovery. Here we combined genome-resolved metagenomics with long-read Nanopore RNA sequencing, yielding 1016 bacterial and 124 archaeal medium-to-high quality MAGs from previously unchartered microbial communities in Arctic hydrothermal vent biofilms. We identified 2965 BGCs from 870 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) comprising a distinctive and rich diversity of BGCs, with ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) predominating across all samples. RiPPs and non-ribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPs), also known to encode metabolites with antimicrobial potential, are represented among the most expressed transcripts. Terpenes, though less expressed, contribute to microbial signaling and defense. Notably, we identify hydrogen cyanide (HCN) synthesis pathways in archaeal genomes, challenging the view that cyanogenesis is restricted to bacteria and eukaryotes. Our findings demonstrate that microbial adaptation to extreme environments favors RiPP-based biosynthesis and that HCN may play a role in archaeal ecological interactions. Moreover, microbial communities in Arctic hydrothermal vent biofilms provide a rich reservoir of unique bioactive compounds, with implications for drug discovery.

articles.title: Issue Publication Information

Near-Quantitative
Electrochemical Upcycling of Halonitrobenzenes
in Wastewater to Valuable Haloanilines over Facet-Engineered Copper
Catalysts
articles.abstract: Abstract Selective electrocatalytic hydrogenation of halonitrobenzenes (HNBs) in wastewater to value-added haloanilines (HANs) offers a sustainable strategy for simultaneous pollutant abatement and resource recovery. However, achieving high HANs selectivity under ambient conditions remains challenging. Here we report a facet-engineered Cu electrocatalyst that enables selective hydrogenation of HNBs to HANs. Using p-chloronitrobenzene (p-CNB) as a model pollutant, the Cu catalyst achieves complete p-CNB removal with a 98.9% p-chloroaniline (p-CAN) selectivity. Mechanistic studies reveal that the outstanding performance of Cu originates from an optimal balance between moderate H* generation and facile desorption of the p-CAN product, which promotes efficient −NO2 to −NH2 reduction while effectively suppressing the over-dechlorination of p-CAN. Furthermore, it is found that the Cu(111) facet is intrinsically more active than Cu(200) and Cu(220), attributable to its higher p-CAN desorption ability. Guided by these insights, a Cu(111)-enriched electrode is rationally engineered, exhibiting an ultrahigh Faradaic efficiency of 99.4%. Finally, a tandem device integrating an electrolyzer and an extraction-distillation separation unit is developed, enabling the efficient recovery of high-purity p-CAN product. This study demonstrates a sustainable electrochemical pathway for converting hazardous pollutants into valuable chemicals, advancing low-carbon wastewater treatment and resource recovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 将废水中的卤代硝基苯 (HNB) 选择性电催化氢化为增值卤代苯胺 (HAN)，为同步污染物减排和资源回收提供了可持续的策略。然而，在环境条件下实现高 HAN 选择性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报道了一种面设计的铜电催化剂，能够将 HNB 选择性氢化为 HAN。使用对氯硝基苯 (p-CNB) 作为模型污染物，Cu 催化剂实现了对氯硝基苯 (p-CNB) 的完全去除，对氯苯胺 (p-CAN) 的选择性为 98.9%。机理研究表明，Cu的优异性能源于适度的H*生成和p-CAN产物的轻松解吸之间的最佳平衡，促进有效地将-NO2还原为-NH2，同时有效抑制p-CAN的过度脱氯。此外，我们发现Cu(111)面本质上比Cu(200)和Cu(220)面更活跃，这归因于其更高的p-CAN解吸能力。在这些见解的指导下，合理设计了富集 Cu(111) 电极，表现出 99.4% 的超高法拉第效率。最后，开发了一种集成电解槽和萃取蒸馏分离装置的串联装置，能够有效回收高纯度的p-CAN产品。这项研究展示了一种可持续的电化学途径，可将有害污染物转化为有价值的化学品，推进低碳废水处理和资源回收。

articles.title:
Multisource
Observation-Constrained Tuning for Air
Quality Forecasting in a Machine Learning-Enhanced NOAA Unified Forecast
System
articles.abstract: Abstract Accurate near-real-time (NRT) air quality forecasting is critical for protecting public health but remains challenged by uncertainties in emissions, meteorology, and initial conditions within traditional chemical transport models (CTMs). We present an observation-driven machine learning framework that integrates multisource satellite products, including VIIRS aerosol optical depth and TEMPO NO2 with U.S. EPA AirNow measurements into a machine-learning surrogate of the NOAA Unified Forecast System (DeepAQM). A ConvLSTM-ResNet fusion module reconstructs spatially continuous surface PM2.5 and O3 fields from sparse observations, providing updated initial conditions for 72 h forecasts across the continental United States. DeepAQM reproduces UFS-AQM spatial patterns with strong agreement (R2 > 0.9 for O3 and up to 0.80 for PM2.5) while maintaining normalized mean bias within ±10%. Observation-updated initial conditions improve early forecast skill, increasing site-level R2 during the first 10 forecast hours from approximately 0.10–0.15 to 0.40–0.50 for PM2.5 and from approximately 0.40 to 0.50 for O3. Observation-based fine-tuning provides additional improvements throughout the 72 h forecast period, increasing overall R2 to 0.41 for PM2.5 and 0.82 for O3 during the independent evaluation period. These results demonstrate that integrating satellite and ground observations within DeepAQM can enhance NRT air quality forecasting and provide a scalable pathway toward globally deployable observation-driven prediction systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 准确的近实时 (NRT) 空气质量预测对于保护公众健康至关重要，但仍然受到传统化学品传输模型 (CTM) 中排放、气象和初始条件的不确定性的挑战。我们提出了一个观测驱动的机器学习框架，该框架将多源卫星产品（包括 VIIRS 气溶胶光学深度和 TEMPO NO2 与美国 EPA AirNow 测量值）集成到 NOAA 统一预报系​​统 (DeepAQM) 的机器学习替代品中。 ConvLSTM-ResNet 融合模块根据稀疏观测重建空间连续的表面 PM2.5 和 O3 场，为美国大陆 72 小时的预测提供更新的初始条件。 DeepAQM 再现了 UFS-AQM 空间模式，具有很强的一致性（O3 的 R2 > 0.9，PM2.5 的 R2 > 0.80），同时将归一化平均偏差保持在 ±10% 以内。观测更新的初始条件提高了早期预报技巧，在前 10 个预报小时内，将 PM2.5 的站点级 R2 从大约 0.10-0.15 增加到 0.40-0.50，将 O3 从大约 0.40 增加到 0.50。基于观测的微调在整个 72 小时预测期内提供了额外的改进，在独立评估期间将 PM2.5 的总体 R2 提高到 0.41，将 O3 的总体 R2 提高到 0.82。这些结果表明，在 DeepAQM 中集成卫星和地面观测可以增强 NRT 空气质量预测，并为全球可部署的观测驱动预测系统提供可扩展的途径。

articles.title:
Machine
Learning-Accelerated
Advancements in Electrocatalytic
CO2 Reduction
articles.abstract: Abstract With growing concerns over climate change, electrochemical CO2 reduction (CO2RR) has attracted significant attention for converting CO2 into valuable products under mild conditions, but catalyst design remains challenging because traditional, experiment-driven approaches are inefficient and time-consuming. Recently, machine learning (ML), as an advanced data-driven technology, has been widely applied to catalyst design and performance prediction, providing new approaches for rapid screening, structural optimization, and mechanistic exploration of catalysts. Building on these recent advances, this review summarizes the latest applications of ML in CO2RR technology, focusing on ML applications in catalyst performance prediction, key descriptor discovery, catalyst screening, mechanistic investigation, and optimization of synthesis parameters. Additionally, this review discusses the challenges faced by ML in CO2RR catalyst development, including data scarcity, poor model generalization, and difficulties in multiobjective optimization, while looking ahead to future directions such as transfer learning, the establishment of automated synthesis platforms, and the integration of multiobjective optimization frameworks, thereby providing a roadmap for the rational design of next-generation CO2RR catalysts that aims to guide the development of data-driven catalyst design approach.

articles.title:
Predicting Bioconcentration
Factors and Concentrations
of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances in Plants with Machine Learning
articles.abstract: Abstract Bioconcentration factors (BCF) and concentrations of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in crops were predicted by four machine learning models using a newly compiled data set composed of 11 crops, 11 plant tissue compartments, and 21 PFAS, as well as diverse soil properties and cultivation conditions. The eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) achieved the best performance, with a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.951 for Log BCF and 0.943 for Log C. Feature importance analysis showed that soil pH and PFAS carbon chain length are key predictors of BCF. Soil PFAS concentration is the primary input feature for PFAS concentrations in plants and shorter growth-cycle plants accumulated higher PFAS concentrations. Root and leaf tissues were distinguished as the primary compartments of PFAS accumulation, exhibiting the highest BCF and concentration levels. Interestingly, although PFAS accumulation in plants generally shows a negative correlation with carbon chain length, root accumulation has a relatively weaker correlation with high levels of accumulation for both short-chain and long-chain PFAS. In contrast, above-ground tissues (particularly leaves) preferentially accumulate short-chain PFAS. These findings could provide valuable insights into the development of management and mitigation strategies to minimize PFAS accumulation in food crops and subsequently human exposure through the food chain.

articles.title:
Dynamic Self-Enhancing
Proton Interface of Oxyhydroxides
Unlocks Concerted Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer for Streamlined
Nitrate-to-Ammonia Conversion
articles.abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic nitrate reduction (NO3RR) to ammonia (NH3) offers a sustainable route for simultaneous environmental remediation and resource recovery, yet it is fundamentally impeded by sluggish proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) due to diffusion-limited proton delivery, thereby severely undermining the Faradaic efficiency and NH3 selectivity. Here, we exploit a cathodically induced alkaline reconstruction strategy to engineer an intrinsic proton-donating CoOOH/NiOOH interface from a bimetallic Co,Ni precursor on copper foam under NO3RR conditions. The reconstructed CoOOH/NiOOH interface, enriched with dense and labile lattice hydroxyls, functions as a localized solid-state proton donor that spontaneously supplies protons through reversible deprotonation. Crucially, this proton-donating behavior is not static but enters a self-enhancing cycle in which nitrate reduction further accelerates the proton dissociation kinetics, creating a positive feedback loop that continuously amplifies the local generation of reactive hydrogen species. Such a unique mechanism achieves rapid and sustained proton delivery, synchronized with electron transfer that is facilitated by the optimized spin state of the metal centers. The resultant concerted PCET streamlines the reaction pathway of the NO3RR to NH3, bypassing unstable intermediates such as *NH2OH and *H2NO, while suppressing the competing hydrogen evolution reaction. Consequently, the CoOOH/NiOOH interface exhibits near-unity ammonia selectivity with a Faradaic efficiency exceeding 98% at high nitrate conversion. We further extend this self-enhancing proton interface to bridge nitrate reduction with poly(lactic acid) depolymerization, directly electrosynthesizing alanine and highlighting the potential for dual waste valorization.

articles.title:
Accounting
for Forest Carbon Loss from Natural Gas
Development in a Major U.S. Gas Region
articles.abstract: Abstract Natural gas development in forested landscapes can cause substantial forest disturbance, yet its impacts on forest carbon remain poorly quantified. In the Appalachian Basin of the United States, where natural gas production is expected to continue expanding in the coming decades, understanding these impacts is important for evaluating trade-offs between energy production and forest ecosystem services. Here, we combine nationwide forest inventory and remotely sensed data within a Bayesian spatiotemporal modeling framework to quantify forest disturbance, carbon loss, and opportunity cost associated with natural gas development between 2008 and 2021. Using permitted well locations in Ohio, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia, we generate pixel-level estimates with associated uncertainty and aggregate results to characterize regional patterns. We estimate that 10 854 ha of forest land were disturbed, resulting in 542 675 (±4275) Mg of forest carbon loss and an opportunity cost of 575 246 (±30 774) Mg of carbon (equivalent to the annual emissions of approximately 464 000 and 492 000 gasoline-powered passenger vehicles, respectively). Disturbance rates were greatest in northern West Virginia, while opportunity costs were highest in northeastern Pennsylvania. To our knowledge, this study provides the first regional-scale quantification of forest carbon loss associated with natural gas development in the Appalachian Basin. The results demonstrate the importance of accounting for forest carbon impacts when evaluating energy development and provide information needed to support future mitigation, planning, and optimization efforts.

articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 森林景观中的天然气开发可能会造成严重的森林干扰，但其对森林碳的影响仍难以量化。在美国阿巴拉契亚盆地，天然气产量预计将在未来几十年继续扩大，了解这些影响对于评估能源生产和森林生态系统服务之间的权衡非常重要。在这里，我们将全国森林清查和遥感数据结合在贝叶斯时空建模框架内，以量化 2008 年至 2021 年间与天然气开发相关的森林干扰、碳损失和机会成本。利用俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州和西弗吉尼亚州允许的井位，我们生成具有相关不确定性的像素级估计和汇总结果，以表征区域模式。我们估计 10 854 公顷林地受到干扰，导致 542 675 (±4275) 毫克森林碳损失和 575 246 (±30 774) 毫克碳的机会成本（分别相当于约 464 000 辆和 492 000 辆汽油动力乘用车的年排放量）。西弗吉尼亚州北部的骚乱率最高，而宾夕法尼亚州东北部的机会成本最高。据我们所知，这项研究首次对阿巴拉契亚盆地天然气开发相关的森林碳损失进行了区域规模的量化。结果证明了在评估能源开发时考虑森林碳影响的重要性，并提供支持未来缓解、规划和优化工作所需的信息。

articles.title:
What Are the Sources
of Unclassified Organosulfates
in the Atmosphere?
articles.abstract: Abstract Organosulfates (OSs) are ubiquitous components of atmospheric aerosols, contributing up to 30% of total aerosol mass, yet their sources remain poorly constrained. Recently, we have compiled 366 ambient OS molecular formulas from previous field studies and found that only about 36% can be assigned to known precursors or formation mechanisms. These mechanisms primarily explain the production of freshly formed OSs via photochemical and/or condensed-phase reactions associated with different precursors. Consequently, 64% of observed OS formulas remain unclassified. Concurrently, laboratory studies have revealed that certain OSs can undergo efficient multiphase transformation through heterogeneous and aqueous-phase reactions, yielding higher-generation OS products. Although such studies are still limited, the identified transformation OS products can account for about 17% of all reported ambient OS formulas and, notably, explain an additional 5% of previously unclassified OS signals. These findings imply that a potential fraction of ambient OSs may not be freshly formed but rather secondary or higher-generation products arising from chemical transformation. Current field analyses and atmospheric models focus mostly on precursor-specific OS formation pathways, largely overlooking the role of OS transformation. We therefore propose that transformation of freshly formed OSs is an important and previously underrecognized source of unclassified ambient OSs.

articles.title:
Understanding Unexpected
Ozone–Health Associations:
Are Secondary Oxidative Pollutants Key?
articles.abstract: Abstract Despite the well-established mechanisms of how ozone (O3) results in adverse health, it is not uncommon for population-based epidemiology studies to find evidence that lower O3 levels are associated with higher risks of disease. Common explanations, such as the scavenging of O3 by nitric oxide near traffic and differential measurement error, cannot fully explain these unexpected associations. Therefore, we propose an alternate explanation for counter-to-hypothesized associations for O3. Specifically, we hypothesize that observed associations between higher levels of O3 and better health outcomes could be a consequence of the complex atmospheric chemistry that occurs in urban and near-urban areas. Low O3 could coincide with active oxidative processes, either through O3 consumption or parallel pathways involving other oxidants. Since these processes can generate toxic but unmeasured secondary products, it would be unsurprising to find inverse associations with O3. In this perspective, we highlight the key evidence supporting this hypothesis. In doing so, we hope that this perspective may inform future plans for air quality measurement and provide context for the interpretation of associations between O3 and health in epidemiology studies.

articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管臭氧 (O3) 导致不良健康的机制已被确立，但基于人群的流行病学研究发现较低 O3 水平与较高疾病风险相关的证据并不罕见。常见的解释，例如交通附近的一氧化氮清除 O3 和差分测量误差，无法完全解释这些意想不到的关联。因此，我们对 O3 的假设关联提出了另一种解释。具体来说，我们假设观察到的较高水平的 O3 与更好的健康结果之间的关联可能是城市和近城市地区发生的复杂大气化学的结果。低 O3 可能与活跃的氧化过程同时发生，无论是通过 O3 消耗还是涉及其他氧化剂的平行途径。由于这些过程会产生有毒但无法测量的次级产品，因此发现与 O3 呈负相关也就不足为奇了。从这个角度来看，我们强调支持这一假设的关键证据。在此过程中，我们希望这一观点可以为未来的空气质量测量计划提供信息，并为流行病学研究中解释 O3 与健康之间的关联提供背景。

articles.title:
Fatty Acid-Derived
Metabolic Indicators and Biomagnification
of Halogenated Organic Contaminants: A Comparative Analysis of Adjacent
Coastal Predator-Based Food Webs
articles.abstract: Abstract Fatty acids (FAs) mediate trophic energy transfer and may reflect biochemical responses to contaminant exposure, yet their linkage with halogenated organic contaminants (HOCs) across adjacent coastal food webs remains unclear. This study comparatively examined the occurrence, biomagnification, and associations between 103 HOCs and 36 FAs in two predator-based food webs from the Pearl River Estuary: a marine fish–dolphin (Sousa chinensis) food web and a mangrove-associated terrestrial insect–spider (Nephila pilipes) food web. The fish–dolphin food web exhibited higher HOC biomagnification (BMFs < 489) and trophic magnification (TMFs < 5.19) than the insect–spider food web (BMFs < 2.78; TMFs < 3.08), although both showed similar biomagnification peaks at log KOW ≈ 7 and log KOA ≈ 11. Multivariate analyses identified 2,2′,4,4′,5,5′-hexachlorobiphenyl (PCB-153), 2,2′,4,4′-tetrabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-47), and a medium-chain chlorinated paraffin congener (C17H29Cl7) as contaminants most strongly associated with dolphin FA profiles, whereas 2-ethylhexyl-2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (TBB), bis(2-ethylhexyl)-tetrabromophthalate (TBPH), and 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane (p,p′-DDT) were predominant contributors in spiders. HOC concentrations showed positive associations with saturated FAs in dolphins but negative associations with polyunsaturated FAs in spiders, and were significantly associated with FA-derived metabolic indices (R2 = 0.234–0.554, p < 0.05), including stearoyl-CoA desaturase 16 (SCD16) and stearoyl-CoA desaturase 18 (SCD18) in dolphins, and delta-6-desaturase (D6D) and de novo lipogenesis (DNL) in spiders. These relationships are correlative and likely reflect the combined influence of food-web characteristics, contaminant exposure, and species-specific physiology. This study provides a comparative assessment of HOC biomagnification and FA-derived metabolic indicators across contrasting predator-based coastal food webs.
articles.title_zh:
脂肪酸衍生
代谢指标和生物放大
卤化有机污染物的分析：相邻污染物的比较分析
沿海捕食者食物网
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 脂肪酸（FA）介导营养能量转移，并可能反映对污染物暴露的生化反应，但它们与邻近沿海食物网的卤化有机污染物（HOC）的联系仍不清楚。本研究比较了珠江口两个基于捕食者的食物网中 103 个 HOC 和 36 个 FA 的出现、生物放大和关联：海洋鱼类-海豚 (Sousa chinensis) 食物网和与红树林相关的陆生昆虫-蜘蛛 (Nephila pilipes) 食物网。鱼-海豚食物网表现出比昆虫-蜘蛛食物网（BMF < 2.78；TMF < 3.08）更高的 HOC 生物放大率（BMF < 489）和营养放大率（TMF < 5.19），尽管两者在 log KOW ≈ 7 和 log KOA ≈ 11 处表现出相似的生物放大峰值。多变量分析确定2,2',4,4',5,5'-六氯联苯 (PCB-153)、2,2',4,4'-四溴二苯醚 (BDE-47) 和中链氯化石蜡同系物 (C17H29Cl7) 是与海豚 FA 谱最密切相关的污染物，而 2,3,4,5-四溴苯甲酸 2-乙基己酯(TBB)、双(2-乙基己基)-四溴邻苯二甲酸酯(TBPH)和1,1,1-三氯-2,2-双(4-氯苯基)乙烷(p,p'-DDT)是蜘蛛中的主要贡献者。 HOC 浓度与海豚中的饱和 FA 呈正相关，但与蜘蛛中的多不饱和 FA 呈负相关，并且与 FA 衍生的代谢指数显着相关（R2 = 0.234–0.554，p < 0.05），包括硬脂酰辅酶 A 去饱和酶 16 (SCD16) 和硬脂酰辅酶 A 去饱和酶 18 (SCD18)。海豚、蜘蛛中的 delta-6-去饱和酶 (D6D) 和从头脂肪生成 (DNL)。这些关系是相关的，可能反映了食物网特征、污染物暴露和物种特异性生理学的综合影响。本研究对基于捕食者的沿海食物网的 HOC 生物放大和 FA 衍生代谢指标进行了比较评估。

articles.title:
Ecological and Structural
Drivers Underlying Species-Specific
Estrogen Receptor α Responses to Estrogenic Chemicals in Mammals
articles.abstract: Abstract Species-specific sensitivity to estrogenic chemicals complicates cross-species extrapolation in environmental risk assessment, yet its mechanistic basis remains poorly understood. Here, we investigated how ecological traits and amino acid variations in estrogen receptor alpha (ERα) mediate responses to estrogenic chemicals across mammals using an integrated New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) framework combining bioinformatics, in silico structural modeling, machine learning (ML), and in vitro transactivation assays. Two-way clustering of 169 mammalian ERα sequences and 107 ecological traits revealed distinct groupings associated with diet, habitat, and reproductive strategies. Homology model analysis showed that omnivorous species tend to possess larger ligand-binding pockets than carnivores and herbivores. In vitro assays of ERα from six mammalian species demonstrated substantial interspecies variability in response to natural and synthetic estrogenic chemicals. A cetacean-specific substitution from Asn to Ser at position 349 (corresponding to Asn349 in human ERα), which alters hydrogen bonding with Tyr537 in helix-12, was associated with aquatic lifestyles and altered receptor responsiveness. Additionally, ML models identified brain-to-body mass ratio as a candidate predictor of ERα-ligand binding domain sequence variation and ERα-mediated in vitro transactivation sensitivity across species. These findings identify ecological and structural drivers of species-specific estrogen sensitivity and provide a mechanistic framework for improving cross-species prediction of chemical effects in environmental risk assessment.
articles.title_zh:
生态和结构
物种特异性的驱动因素
哺乳动物雌激素受体 α 对雌激素化学物质的反应
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 物种特异性对雌激素化学物质的敏感性使环境风险评估中的跨物种外推变得复杂，但其机制基础仍知之甚少。在这里，我们使用结合了生物信息学、计算机结构建模、机器学习 (ML) 和体外反式激活测定的集成新方法 (NAM) 框架，研究了雌激素受体 α (ERα) 的生态特征和氨基酸变异如何介导哺乳动物对雌激素化学物质的反应。 169 个哺乳动物 ERα 序列和 107 个生态特征的双向聚类揭示了与饮食、栖息地和繁殖策略相关的不同分组。同源模型分析表明，杂食性物种往往比肉食性动物和草食性动物拥有更大的配体结合袋。对六种哺乳动物的 ERα 进行的体外测定表明，对天然和合成雌激素化学物质的反应存在显着的种间差异。鲸类特异性的 349 位 Asn 替换为 Ser（对应于人类 ERα 中的 Asn349），改变了 helix-12 中 Tyr537 的氢键，与水生生活方式和受体反应性改变有关。此外，ML 模型将大脑与身体质量比确定为 ERα 配体结合域序列变异和 ERα 介导的跨物种体外反式激活敏感性的候选预测因子。这些发现确定了物种特异性雌激素敏感性的生态和结构驱动因素，并为改善环境风险评估中化学效应的跨物种预测提供了机制框架。

articles.title:
Prioritizing and
Grouping Food Contact Chemicals:
From Chaos to Clarity
articles.abstract: Abstract At least 2,160 food contact chemicals (FCCs) are known to migrate into foodstuffs, and some of them, such as certain bisphenols and ortho-phthalates, have been partially regulated in a few geographic regions due to health risks. However, the current approach to chemicals management is slow and can lead to regrettable substitutions, as seen with bisphenol A (BPA, CAS 80-05-7) being replaced by bisphenol S (BPS, CAS 80-09-1). To help address these issues and provide evidence-based guidance, we systematically prioritized the currently known 15,159 FCCs based on their well-known human health hazards and exposure potential from food contact materials (FCMs). Overall, 1,222 FCCs make up the FCCprio List. These FCCs are carcinogenic, mutagenic, toxic for reproduction, toxic for specific target organs, endocrine disrupting, persistent, bioaccumulative, and/or mobile, based on GHS-aligned hazard data. 94 FCCs are assigned to the highest tier (Tier 1) because of evidence for migration into food and presence in humans from human biomonitoring programs. We then grouped all known FCCs by chemical structure and identified 38 priority structural groups with a particularly high fraction of known hazardous chemicals, including well-known priority groups such as ortho-phthalates and PFASs as well as less-discussed groups (e.g., primary aromatic amines, organophosphates, isocyanates). Importantly, 4,222 FCCs fall into priority groups, meaning they are structurally closely related to hazardous FCCs, and 70% of these FCCs lack adequate hazard data─indicating significant knowledge gaps and the potential for regrettable substitutions. While these results highlight potential for prioritizing data-poor FCCs through grouping, ultimately more holistic strategies, including mixture toxicity assessment or testing finished FCMs for biological activity, are needed to reduce the overall human exposure to hazardous or untested FCCs migrating from FCMs.
articles.title_zh:
优先考虑和
食品接触化学品分组：
从混乱到清晰
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 已知至少有 2,160 种食品接触化学品 (FCC) 会迁移到食品中，其中一些化学品（例如某些双酚和邻苯二甲酸酯）由于健康风险而在一些地理区域受到部分监管。然而，目前的化学品管理方法进展缓慢，并且可能导致令人遗憾的替代，例如双酚 A（BPA，CAS 80-05-7）被双酚 S（BPS，CAS 80-09-1）替代。为了帮助解决这些问题并提供基于证据的指导，我们根据其众所周知的人类健康危害和食品接触材料 (FCM) 的暴露潜力，系统地对当前已知的 15,159 种 FCC 进行了优先排序。总体而言，FCCprio 列表中有 1,222 个 FCC。根据与 GHS 一致的危害数据，这些 FCC 具有致癌性、致突变性、生殖毒性、特定靶器官毒性、内分泌干扰性、持久性、生物累积性和/或移动性。 94 个 FCC 被分配到最高级别（第 1 级），因为人类生物监测计划中有证据表明其会迁移到食品中并存在于人体中。然后，我们按化学结构对所有已知的 FCC 进行了分组，并确定了 38 个优先结构组，其中已知危险化学品的比例特别高，包括众所周知的优先组，例如邻苯二甲酸盐和 PFAS，以及较少讨论的组（例如，伯芳香胺、有机磷酸酯、异氰酸酯）。重要的是，4,222 个 FCC 属于优先组，这意味着它们在结构上与危险 FCC 密切相关，并且其中 70% 的 FCC 缺乏足够的危害数据，这表明存在重大知识差距以及令人遗憾的替代品的可能性。虽然这些结果凸显了通过分组对数据贫乏的 FCC 进行优先排序的潜力，但最终需要更全面的策略，包括混合物毒性评估或测试成品 FCM 的生物活性，以减少人类总体暴露于从 FCM 迁移的危险或未经测试的 FCC。

articles.title:
Dynamics
and Controls of Microbial Hydrogen Consumption
in Porous Media
articles.abstract: Abstract While nuclear energy contributes significantly to the global energy supply, the long-term management of radioactive waste remains challenging. Deep geological repositories, in which the waste is buried within a low-permeability host rock, are considered the safest storage option. However, hydrogen gas (H2) generated by steel container corrosion may accumulate and create an overpressure that threatens host rock integrity. Access tunnels will be filled with gas-permeable material (such as a sand-bentonite mixture) that mechanically lowers pressure by gas diffusion, but microbial H2 consumption is key to enhancing safety and cost-effectiveness. Hydrogenotrophy is well established in deep subsurface sulfate-reducing bacteria, whereas the activity of other hydrogenotrophs under H2-replete conditions remains poorly constrained. This study examines microbial H2 consumption under repository-relevant conditions in partially saturated sand-bentonite exposed to elevated H2 concentrations. Over 3 months, continuous gas composition and pressure monitoring showed rapid H2 depletion driven by its microbial oxidation coupled to sulfate reduction, methanogenesis, and iron reduction. Water saturation and electron acceptor availability strongly controlled H2 consumption rates. These results clarify the constraints on microbial H2 oxidation in deep geological repositories and inform safety assessments related to gas-induced overpressure.
articles.title_zh:
动力学
微生物氢消耗及其控制
在多孔介质中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 虽然核能对全球能源供应做出了重大贡献，但放射性废物的长期管理仍然具有挑战性。深层地质处置库将废物埋在低渗透性的主岩中，被认为是最安全的储存选择。然而，钢容器腐蚀产生的氢气 (H2) 可能会积聚并产生威胁母岩完整性的超压。通道将填充透气材料（例如砂膨润土混合物），通过气体扩散以机械方式降低压力，但微生物氢气消耗是提高安全性和成本效益的关键。氢营养菌在深层地下硫酸盐还原细菌中已得到很好的建立，而其他氢营养菌在充满氢气的条件下的活性仍然受到很少的限制。本研究研究了暴露于高浓度 H2 的部分饱和砂膨润土在储存库相关条件下的微生物 H2 消耗情况。超过 3 个月的时间，连续的气体成分和压力监测显示，由于微生物氧化以及硫酸盐还原、产甲烷作用和铁还原，导致氢气快速消耗。水饱和度和电子受体可用性强烈控制氢气消耗率。这些结果阐明了深层地质储藏库中微生物 H2 氧化的限制，并为与气体引起的超压相关的安全评估提供了信息。

articles.title:
Manganese
Oxides Incubated in Acidic Forest Soil Retain
More Organic Carbon Than Iron Oxides
articles.abstract: Abstract Iron (oxyhydr)oxides are well-recognized contributors to soil carbon (C) storage, but the effects of manganese oxides on carbon storage and transformation are relatively unexplored. Here, the relative capacities of Fe and Mn oxides to bind and stabilize soil organic C were directly compared using an in situ incubation experiment. Quartz sands coated with either poorly crystalline Mn(III/IV) oxides or Fe(III) oxides, or left uncoated, were buried in a temperate forest soil for up to one year. Chemical extractions, X-ray absorption and photon spectroscopies, scanning electron microscopy, and neutron scattering were used to evaluate organic and mineral associations and transformations during the incubation. At the end of the 1-year study, Mn oxide stored ∼11× more carbon (42.0 ± 14.3 mg C/m2 oxide) than Fe oxide (3.72 ± 0.37 mg C/m2 oxide) per unit surface area. Manganese oxidation state changed over time, likely reflecting reactions between organic C and Mn oxide, while Fe oxidation state remained unaltered. Total organic C that was associated with Mn oxide was relatively enriched in carboxylic and O-alkyl-C compared to Fe oxides and quartz, either due to preferential sorption or oxidation on the mineral surface. Mn oxides also sorbed high amounts of Ca despite being incubated in an acidic, base-cation depleted soil, which potentially facilitated C sorption. Our study demonstrates that Mn oxides, with the assistance of Ca-bridging, have a greater potential to stabilize organic C than Fe oxides in acidic environments despite higher reactivity.
articles.title_zh:
锰
酸性森林土壤中培育的氧化物
有机碳含量高于氧化铁
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 铁（羟基）氧化物是公认的土壤碳（C）储存贡献者，但锰氧化物对碳储存和转化的影响相对尚未被探索。在这里，使用原位培养实验直接比较了铁和锰氧化物结合和稳定土壤有机碳的相对能力。涂覆有结晶不良的 Mn(III/IV) 氧化物或 Fe(III) 氧化物或未涂覆的石英砂被埋在温带森林土壤中长达一年。使用化学萃取、X射线吸收和光子光谱、扫描电子显微镜和中子散射来评估培养过程中的有机和矿物质的缔合和转化。在为期 1 年的研究结束时，每单位表面积氧化锰储存的碳（42.0 ± 14.3 mg C/m2 氧化物）比铁氧化物（3.72 ± 0.37 mg C/m2 氧化物）多约 11 倍。锰的氧化态随时间变化，可能反映了有机碳和锰氧化物之间的反应，而铁的氧化态保持不变。与铁氧化物和石英相比，与锰氧化物相关的总有机碳相对富含羧基和O-烷基-C，这可能是由于矿物表面的优先吸附或氧化所致。尽管在酸性、碱阳离子耗尽的土壤中培养，锰氧化物也吸附了大量的钙，这可能促进碳的吸附。我们的研究表明，在酸性环境中，锰氧化物在钙桥联的帮助下比铁氧化物具有更大的稳定有机碳的潜力，尽管其反应性更高。

articles.title:
High-Resolution
Assessment of Terrestrial Carbon Storage
and Restoration Benefits in China, 1990–2023
articles.abstract: Abstract Terrestrial ecosystems serve as critical carbon sinks, playing an important role in the global carbon cycle and climate regulation. However, previous estimates of carbon storage in China’s terrestrial ecosystems remain uncertain due to variability in data sources and methodological approaches. This study integrates multisource remote sensing data with extensive field-sampling data sets of carbon density, leveraging machine learning models to provide a comprehensive estimation of multiyear carbon storage and annual dynamics across multiple carbon pools. We estimated project-region carbon-stock changes using a scenario-based accounting framework. The total carbon storage, encompassing vegetation biomass and soil organic carbon, is estimated at 113.48 Pg C, with 20.4% in vegetation biomass and 79.6% in soil. Across land-use types, forests store the largest share, with 47.99 Pg C, followed by grasslands, croplands, barren lands, shrublands, and wetlands, which stored 32.32, 18.00, 14.65, 0.49, and 0.02 Pg C, respectively. National carbon stocks fluctuated over the study period but increased by 6.62 Pg C from 2014 to 2023. Scenario-based accounting indicates an additional baseline-adjusted project-region carbon-stock gain of 0.495 Pg C within major restoration regions during 2014–2023, equivalent to 0.050 Pg C yr–1. These results provide a high-resolution reconstruction of China’s terrestrial carbon stocks and clarify recent carbon-stock changes across ecosystems, regions, and major restoration areas.
articles.title_zh:
高分辨率
陆地碳储存评估
1990-2023 年中国的恢复效益
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 陆地生态系统作为重要的碳汇，在全球碳循环和气候调节中发挥着重要作用。然而，由于数据来源和方法方法的差异，之前对中国陆地生态系统碳储量的估计仍然不确定。这项研究将多源遥感数据与广泛的碳密度实地采样数据集相结合，利用机器学习模型对多个碳库的多年碳储存和年度动态进行全面估计。我们使用基于情景的核算框架估算了项目区域的碳储量变化。总碳储量（包括植被生物量和土壤有机碳）估计为 113.48 Pg C，其中植被生物量占 20.4%，土壤占 79.6%。在各种土地利用类型中，森林储存量最大，为 47.99 Pg C，其次是草地、农田、贫瘠地、灌木地和湿地，分别储存了 32.32、18.00、14.65、0.49 和 0.02 Pg C。国家碳储量在研究期间有所波动，但从 2014 年到 2023 年增加了 6.62 Pg C。基于情景的核算表明，2014 年至 2023 年期间，主要恢复区域内经基线调整的项目区域碳储量额外增加了 0.495 Pg C，相当于 0.050 Pg C yr–1。这些结果提供了中国陆地碳储量的高分辨率重建，并阐明了生态系统、区域和主要恢复区的近期碳储量变化。

articles.title: Aerosol-Assisted Metal Poisoning of Cu/SSZ-13 during NH 3 -SCR Operation
articles.abstract: Abstract Cu/SSZ-13 is a benchmark catalyst for the selective catalytic reduction (SCR) of NOx with NH3 in diesel exhaust aftertreatment, but its activity can be severely impaired by alkali and alkaline-earth metal poisoning. Conventional impregnation of catalysts with such poisons involves introducing metal species prior to catalytic testing. This means that any poisoning that develops concurrently with catalyst operation is not captured. Here, we develop an aerosol-assisted, reaction-coupled poisoning platform that continuously delivers metal-containing aqueous aerosols to SCR catalysts under hydrated NH3–SCR conditions. At nearly identical K loadings, aerosol-assisted poisoning caused substantially greater deactivation of Cu/SSZ-13 than conventional impregnation of the catalyst, with a more pronounced activity loss after poisoning at 400 °C than at 200 °C. The enhanced deactivation was accompanied by a more spatially extensive K distribution, stronger perturbations of the zeolite framework, preferential alteration of 8-membered-ring-associated [Cu(OH)]+–Z species, spectroscopic signatures consistent with CuOx aggregation, and partial neutralization of Brønsted acid sites. Similar pathway- and temperature-dependent deactivation trends were observed for Na-, Mg-, and Ca-poisoned Cu/SSZ-13 and for K-poisoned V2O5–WO3/TiO2. These results establish aerosol-assisted poisoning as a controlled, accelerated approach for evaluating metal-induced deactivation of SCR catalysts under hydrated reaction conditions.
articles.title_zh: 气溶胶辅助 Cu/SSZ-13 期间的金属中毒 NH 3 -SCR操作
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 Cu/SSZ-13 是柴油机尾气后处理中用 NH3 选择性催化还原 (SCR) NOx 的基准催化剂，但其活性会因碱金属和碱土金属中毒而严重受损。传统的用此类毒物浸渍催化剂涉及在催化测试之前引入金属物质。这意味着与催化剂运行同时发生的任何中毒都不会被捕获。在这里，我们开发了一种气溶胶辅助、反应耦合中毒平台，该平台可在水合 NH3-SCR 条件下连续向 SCR 催化剂输送含金属的水性气溶胶。在几乎相同的 K 负载量下，气溶胶辅助中毒导致 Cu/SSZ-13 的失活程度比传统的催化剂浸渍要大得多，400 °C 中毒后的活性损失比 200 °C 更明显。失活的增强伴随着更广泛的空间 K 分布、更强的沸石框架扰动、8 元环相关 [Cu(OH)]+-Z 物种的优先改变、与 CuOx 聚集一致的光谱特征以及布朗斯台德酸位点的部分中和。对于 Na、Mg 和 Ca 中毒的 Cu/SSZ-13 以及 K 中毒的 V2O5-WO3/TiO2，观察到类似的途径和温度依赖性失活趋势。这些结果确立了气溶胶辅助中毒作为一种受控、加速的方法，用于评估水合反应条件下金属诱导的 SCR 催化剂失活。

articles.title:
Associations
between Prenatal Exposure to Perchlorate,
Thiocyanate, and Nitrate and Child Neurodevelopment in the MARBLES
Study
articles.abstract: Abstract Associations between prenatal exposure to perchlorate, thiocyanate, and nitrate and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) remain largely unexplored. We investigated these associations in the MARBLES cohort, a prospective cohort with an elevated familial likelihood of ASD. A total of 310 mothers provided 1916 urine samples during pregnancy, and their children were classified at age 3 years as typically developing (TD), ASD, or non-TD (developmental concerns not meeting ASD diagnostic criteria). We estimated relative risks for ASD and non-TD compared with TD using Poisson regression and assessed mixture effects using quantile G-computation and Bayesian kernel machine regression. Overall and mixture analyses showed no significant associations between prenatal exposure to these NIS inhibitors and the child neurodevelopmental outcomes. However, stratified analyses identified several context-specific associations according to child sex, trimester of exposure, maternal urinary iodine concentration, and passive smoking status, some of which remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. These findings suggest that susceptibility to prenatal exposure to perchlorate, thiocyanate, and nitrate may vary across population subgroups and exposure windows. Although these subgroup-specific associations should be considered hypothesis generating, they highlight the need for future studies integrating thyroid biomarkers and mechanistic approaches to better understand thyroid-related pathways underlying child neurodevelopment.
articles.title_zh:
协会
产前接触高氯酸盐之间，
弹珠中的硫氰酸盐、硝酸盐和儿童神经发育
学习
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 产前接触高氯酸盐、硫氰酸盐和硝酸盐与自闭症谱系障碍 (ASD) 之间的关联在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们在 MABLES 队列中研究了这些关联，这是一个自闭症谱系障碍家族可能性较高的前瞻性队列。共有 310 名母亲在怀孕期间提供了 1916 份尿液样本，她们的孩子在 3 岁时被分类为典型发育 (TD)、ASD 或非 TD（发育问题不符合 ASD 诊断标准）。我们使用泊松回归估计了 ASD 和非 TD 与 TD 相比的相对风险，并使用分位数 G 计算和贝叶斯核机回归评估了混合效应。总体分析和混合分析显示，产前接触这些 NIS 抑制剂与儿童神经发育结果之间没有显着关联。然而，分层分析根据儿童性别、妊娠三个月暴露情况、母亲尿碘浓度和被动吸烟状况确定了几种特定背景的关联，其中一些在错误发现率校正后仍然显着。这些发现表明，不同人群亚组和暴露窗口对产前接触高氯酸盐、硫氰酸盐和硝酸盐的易感性可能有所不同。尽管这些亚组特异性关联应被视为假设生成，但它们强调未来研究需要整合甲状腺生物标志物和机制方法，以更好地了解儿童神经发育背后的甲状腺相关途径。

articles.title:
Long-Term Monitoring
of Greenhouse Gas Emissions and
Interpretable Machine Learning Models for Methane Prediction in Dairy
Cattle Slurry Storage
articles.abstract: Abstract Greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from continuously filled dairy cattle slurry storage remain difficult to estimate under practical conditions. This study monitored methane (CH4), nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions, and slurry physicochemical properties for 15 months in laboratory-scale storage tanks designed to reproduce key features of on-farm storage, including continuous filling, farm-derived temperature dynamics, and periodic emptying events. N2O concentrations remained below 0.5 ppm and contributed negligibly to measured direct GHG emissions. In contrast, CH4 showed pronounced seasonal variability: 94.5% of annual CH4 emissions occurred during summer and autumn, whereas only 5.5% occurred during winter and spring. Summer emptying caused a sharp decline in the CH4 flux followed by partial recovery, whereas emptying during colder periods had limited effects. Machine learning (ML) models achieved robust performance during temporal external validation (R2 = 0.82) and identified pH, temperature, and volatile fatty acids as key nonlinear predictors of CH4 emissions. By combining cross-season monitoring with interpretable ML models, this study highlights the importance of long-term observations for characterizing CH4 emissions from continuously filled dairy cattle slurry storage estimation and targeted mitigation.
articles.title_zh:
长期监测
温室气体排放量和
用于乳制品甲烷预测的可解释机器学习模型
牛泥储存
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 在实际条件下，连续填充奶牛淤浆储存所产生的温室气体（GHG）排放量仍然难以估计。这项研究在实验室规模的储罐中监测甲烷 (CH4)、一氧化二氮 (N2O) 排放和泥浆物理化学性质长达 15 个月，旨在重现农场储存的关键特征，包括连续填充、农场产生的温度动态和定期排空事件。 N2O 浓度保持在 0.5 ppm 以下，对测量的直接温室气体排放量的贡献可以忽略不计。相比之下，CH4 表现出明显的季节变化：每年 CH4 排放量的 94.5% 发生在夏季和秋季，而只有 5.5% 发生在冬季和春季。夏季排空导致 CH4 通量急剧下降，随后部分恢复，而寒冷时期的排空影响有限。机器学习 (ML) 模型在时间外部验证期间实现了稳健的性能 (R2 = 0.82)，并将 pH、温度和挥发性脂肪酸确定为 CH4 排放的关键非线性预测因子。通过将跨季节监测与可解释的机器学习模型相结合，本研究强调了长期观察对于表征连续填充的奶牛粪浆储存估算和有针对性的缓解所产生的甲烷排放的重要性。

articles.title:
Expanding
the Scope of PFAS Research to Include Adipose
Tissues
articles.abstract: Abstract The occurrence and burden of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in adipose tissue of humans and wildlife represent an underexamined dimension of PFAS exposure. While most PFAS research has focused on ionic substances that accumulate in tissues such as liver and blood, there is growing evidence that a distinct and diverse suite of neutral PFAS bioaccumulate in adipose tissue. This Perspective synthesizes recent data illustrating the substantial contribution of some adipose-associated PFAS to overall body burdens, applies quantum chemical modeling to exemplify additional PFAS likely to partition into adipose tissue, and examines analytical blindspots that have limited their detection to date. We show that certain neutral PFAS possess partitioning properties comparable to legacy persistent organic pollutants, which, provided that they are sufficiently persistent, can lead to bioaccumulation in adipose tissue. We further outline the analytical challenge of extracting, detecting, and quantifying neutral PFAS in matrices rich in storage lipids and discuss the implications for exposure assessment, toxicology, and environmental surveillance. Finally, we identify key research needs and call for expanded monitoring strategies that capture the full chemical space of PFAS bioaccumulation.
articles.title_zh:
扩展
PFAS 研究范围包括脂肪
纸巾
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：人类和野生动物脂肪组织中全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 的出现和负担代表了 PFAS 暴露的一个未被充分审查的方面。虽然大多数 PFAS 研究都集中在肝脏和血液等组织中积累的离子物质，但越来越多的证据表明，一组独特且多样化的中性 PFAS 在脂肪组织中生物积累。本视角综合了最新的数据，说明了一些与脂肪相关的 PFAS 对整体身体负担的重大贡献，应用量子化学模型来举例说明可能分解到脂肪组织中的其他 PFAS，并检查了迄今为止限制其检测的分析盲点。我们表明，某些中性 PFAS 具有与传统持久性有机污染物相当的分配特性，只要它们具有足够的持久性，就可以导致脂肪组织中的生物累积。我们进一步概述了在富含储存脂质的基质中提取、检测和定量中性 PFAS 的分析挑战，并讨论了其对暴露评估、毒理学和环境监测的影响。最后，我们确定了关键的研究需求，并呼吁扩大监测策略，以捕获 PFAS 生物累积的全部化学空间。
